name: herdr-app
summary: Release builds send one anonymous usage report a day to telemetry.herdr.dev. It contains a random install ID, app and core versions, OS and architecture, bucketed usage counts, known agent and layout names, and command names. It excludes terminal text, prompts, file contents and paths.

optOut.instructions: Open Settings → Privacy and turn telemetry off. Or set "telemetry": false in settings.json (this also deletes the install ID and unsent reports). For a single run, set DO_NOT_TRACK=1 or HERDR_TELEMETRY=0.
